summary: Mount Rainier NP ridge lookout built 1930 and abandoned by 1941; a new lookout went up 1,200 feet down the ridge in 1948; footings and remnants remain.

facts.design: frame cab on a short tower, built 1930
facts.status_note: Abandoned by 1941 and gone per FFLOS and FireLookout.com. WillhiteWeb cites a 1949 trip report that suggests it still stood, and another source that says lightning destroyed it in the 1950s.

access.note: Reached on foot inside Mount Rainier National Park; WillhiteWeb describes the route along the ridge from Sunset Park

visit.trail_note: Follow the ridge from Sunset Park. WillhiteWeb says parts of the old trail still exist and that footings, an outhouse hole and cans remain at the site.

events.note: Frame cab on a short tower. FFLOS and FireLookout.com say 1930; WillhiteWeb says constructed 1929 and opened 1930
Frank Slagle had a Forest Service summer job at the Sunset lookout station, per a 1930 Chehalis Bee-Nugget item quoted by WillhiteWeb
A new lookout was placed 1,200 feet down the same ridge. WillhiteWeb does not say it replaced this cab
A 1949 Mountaineers trip report hints the structure was still standing, per WillhiteWeb
Registered April 3, 2020, nominated by Tammy McLeod

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and FireLookout.com give 1930; WillhiteWeb says constructed in 1929 and opened in 1930. The record and story use 1930 and note WillhiteWeb's account.

FFLOS and FireLookout.com say it was abandoned by 1941 and is gone. WillhiteWeb cites a 1949 report that hints it still stood, and another source that says lightning destroyed it in the 1950s. Not resolved; the story gives both.
FFLOS gives 7,176 ft (2,187 m), which matches the brief. WillhiteWeb gives 6,718 ft. Not resolved; elevation is not a facts key, so it is not recorded.
FFLOS uses Colonnades, FireLookout.com uses Collonnade, and WillhiteWeb reports a 1930 news item calling the first station Sunset Lookout. The story notes the earlier name.

sources.title: Colonnade Lookout - Mt. Rainier National Park

notes_for_editor: The brief matches FFLOS on build year, coordinates and registration (April 3, 2020, nominated by Tammy McLeod). The brief's conflict note ('They share a register number') was not checked. WillhiteWeb disputes the elevation (6,718 ft). Search snippets from FFLOS and FireLookout.com Sunset Park pages say a 1948 Sunset Park lookout replaced Colonnades; those pages were not fetched, so nothing here cites them. That lookout may deserve its own record. The page gives only the decade (the 1950s) for the lightning account, so no destroyed event is recorded. Reads: 5 pages, 2 searches.
